description: 1945-built Beech C-45 Expeditor FACh 488, donated by the FACh to the town of Gorbea in 1984 and displayed in the Plazoleta Reinaldo Martín Muller opposite the police station; restored by the FACh and municipality in 2010-11 and re-inaugurated May 2011 (modocharlie.com; es.wikipedia Beechcraft Model 18 survivors). Photographed on Flickr as 'C-45 Beechcraft 488'.
museum_name: Plazoleta Reinaldo Martín Muller C-45 Monument, Gorbea
